entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow is expected to lower to 700 metres Friday morning, and to 400 metres by Friday evening. Expect 1 to 3 cm to accumulate above 700 metres and lesser amounts to 400 metres.

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers are expected to develop about the higher parts of the road early Saturday morning. During Saturday morning, 1 to 2 cm of snow may accumulate above 1000 metres.

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow is expected to lower to 900 metres late tonight, then gradually lower to 400 metres during Friday. Expect 4 to 8 cm to accumulate about Homer Tunnel and lesser amounts to 400 metres.

entry.title: Strong Wind Watch
entry.summary: A period of westerly winds this morning, followed by southerly winds from afternoon. Winds may approach severe gale in exposed places. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate. Changes: Onset time brought forward to 9am to cover a period of strong westerly winds this morning.

entry.summary: Southerly winds may approach severe gale in exposed places. Winds easing from the west during the afternoon. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers to about 800 metres until 9pm Friday and 2 to 4 cm could accumulate about the the summit. Between 9pm Friday and 4am Saturday, snow lowering to about 400 metres east of the summit and another 1 cm or so could accumulate.
